verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export feature, but some of a user's data is portable by design. Review settings and custom rules live in a plain `greptile.json` file in the user's own repository. Review comments can be pulled out via the MCP server or as raw text from `greptile review --agent`. Self-hosted deployments keep logs on customer servers. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all account data (reviews, learned preferences from reactions, custom patterns, knowledge base) in open formats, an account offboarding/deletion path, a public API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and any independent confirmation that users can actually leave with their data.
